study: A03E8b source-only SI conditional static-halo neutrino gravitational wake Green coefficient from published collisionless Eq.(19)-(20) and frozen F±; NOT eBOSS galaxy xi or evolving CLASS forecast
registration_boundary: Written after E8a frozen source and illustrative FD-relative ratios; new post-hoc theoretical SI unit derivation and deterministic tests only; no retroactive A03 acceptance threshold

paper.eq_source: Section 3.2 Eq.(14)-(20) linear isotropic collisionless distribution and resonant occupation; use exact non-approximated denominator of Eq.(20) rather than empirically fitted mu(v)
paper.source_generalization: At fixed identical halo potential, physical k, redshift, v_parallel and species degeneracy, F±/F0 replaces FD resonant occupation while published mass-dependent SI prefactor remains. No astrophysical halo model or independent evolved +,- potentials.

physical_reference.conversion_rule_for_future_eBOSS_comovin: k_phys=(1+z)k_comoving; never silently substitute comoving k in static physical Eq20
physical_reference.z_label: Mathematical midpoint only, not measured eBOSS z_eff
physical_reference.v_label: Existing 200 km/s diagnostic reference, not measured eBOSS relative velocity
physical_reference.k_label: Illustrative physical wavenumber in existing linear test band, not an eBOSS fitted selection

formula: K_FD=|g_nu,k/Phi_k| = (2 N_nu G m_nu^4 |v_parallel|)/(hbar^3 k_phys)*1/(exp(q_res)+1) in units m^-1 under published static-halo Eq20. K_plus=K_FD*Fplus(q_res)/FFD(q_res), K_minus likewise. For signed v, assign sign to K. q_res=m_nu[eV]*|v_parallel|[m/s]/(c[m/s]*T_nu(z)[eV]).
output_scope: Conditional per-unit-potential gravitational susceptibility at fixed halo potential, physical k, v_parallel, species; NO physical galactic ξ1 ξ3, no survey P(k), no z-conditioned window/covariance

F+-F- equals source ratio times FD Green coefficient
